title: Take It Apart
prompt: Fast garage punk in E minor: two distorted guitars, bass and drums, no vocals.

edits.explanation: Interpreted "Double time on the drums" as: double-time. Drums (Build, Verse 1, Chorus 1, Verse 2, Chorus 2, Bridge, Final Chorus, Outro (bars 5–16, 21–36, 41–48, 53–68)): double-time feel: each bar’s groove played twice as fast (backbeat on every off-beat).
Interpreted "Make the drums busier" as: busier. Drums (Pre-Chorus 1, Pre-Chorus 2 (bars 17–20, 37–40)): added 4 hi-hat subdivisions, 17 ghost snares, 4 syncopated kicks.
